claims.claim: Exelon Q2 2026 issuer reporting confirms $0.43 adjusted operating EPS, reaffirmed $2.81-$2.91 full-year guidance and growth near the top end of 5%-7% through 2029, while utilities continued rate-base investment and reliability execution.

risks.risk: Regulatory recovery, affordability pressure and financing costs can alter the timing and return profile of utility investment.

unknowns.unknown: Alpha must source-address valuation and complete numeric underwriting; this Scout artifact does not score the company.

claims.claim: Execution evidence improved because Exelon reported approximately 86% of planned 2026 debt financing completed and reaffirmed earnings guidance rather than relying only on prospective large-load demand narratives.

risks.risk: Debt execution does not remove regulatory and capital-market sensitivity.

unknowns.unknown: Project-level returns from incremental large-load infrastructure remain unverified here.
